title: Organization Federation Settings
description: Details that define how to connect one MongoDB Cloud organization to one federated authentication service.

federatedDomains.description: List of domains associated with the organization's identity provider.

hasRoleMappings.description: Flag that indicates whether this organization has role mappings configured.

id.description: Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies this federation.

identityProviderId.description: Legacy 20-hexadecimal digit string that identifies the identity provider connected to this organization.

identityProviderStatus.description: String enum that indicates whether the identity provider is active.
